claude.performance_metric: completed $547.4M IPO (Nasdaq: PECO, Jul 2021); FY2021 revenue +7.0% to $532.8M; net income $17.2M (from prior net loss)
claude.rationale: The slice documents a favorable realized trajectory: the registrant remained continuously reporting, completed an underwritten IPO, grew revenue 7.0%, and swung from a FY2019 net loss to consecutive years of net income, with total debt declining. No documented disruption at the product/process interface (p4=0) — the third-party asset-management revenue line grew 5.2% — and no documented fracture at the process/organization interface (p5=0); the G&A increase is attributed to new public-company insurance costs and prior-year COVID-related compensation, not operational-organizational conflict. The larger earn-out liability reflects improved market conditions and the IPO, not model incompatibility (t2=0), and nothing in the slice speaks to controlling-intent archetype incoherence (t1=0).

gemini.performance_metric: Total revenues were $532.8 million for fiscal year 2021, up 7.0% from $498.0 million in fiscal year 2020
gemini.rationale: The provided evidence slice does not document any disruption at the product/process interface (p4_pathway) or fracture at the process/organization interface (p5_pathway). The company successfully completed an IPO, grew revenues, and achieved net income, with no mention of integration failures or operational incoherence.

grok.performance_metric: IPO July 2021 ($547.4M gross); assets retained, revenue +7%
grok.rationale: The FY2021 10-K record shows continuity of the operating business through the 3-5 year window: total revenues rose 7.0% to $532.8M, net income turned positive, and total assets remained ~$4.67B with no product-line or process incoherence disclosed. Fees and management income from the third-party asset-management line also rose modestly, and G&A increases are attributed to IPO-related D&O insurance and compensation normalization rather than any operations-vs-organization fracture. No realized disruption at the product/process or process/organization interfaces is documented.
